children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 1.3.6 as follows: "If any provision of this Sub-Contract is declared invalid, unenforceable or illegal by the courts of any jurisdiction to which it is subject, such invalidity, unenforceability or illegality shall not prejudice or affect the validity, enforceability or legality of the remaining provisions of this Sub-Contract."

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.3A as follows:

children.name: text
children: "The Sub-Contractor acknowledges that failure by the Sub-Contractor to comply with the provisions of clause 2.3 may cause delay and/or disruption to the Main Contract Works and/or any part thereof and/or may cause the Contractor to suffer costs, loss and/or damage. The Sub-Contractor shall plan, carry out and complete the Sub-Contract Works and any Section in accordance with the Sub-Contract and will not delay, disrupt or contribute to any delay or disruption to any part of the Main Contract Works due to its own default. Provided that the Contractor shall keep the Sub-Contractor informed of the progress of the Main Contract Works and shall co-ordinate them to allow the Sub-Contractor to proceed in accordance with the Sub-Contractors Programme."

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.3B as follows: "Without prejudice to any other rights and remedies of the Contractor, if actual progress of the Sub-Contract Works or any Section does not comply with clause 2.3 due to the default of the Sub-Contractor, then the Contractor shall be entitled to require the Sub-Contractor to produce a revised programme and proposals to ensure completion of the Sub-Contract Works or any Section in accordance with clause 2.3."

children.name: text
children: Insert after "Requirements" in line 5: "and/or in the Employers Requirements."

children.name: text
children: In line 1 after "Any" insert "inadequacy, departure, omission, discrepancy, divergence or"; and In line 6 after "the" insert "inadequacy, departure, omission, discrepancy, divergence or"; and Add at the end of this clause: "The Sub-Contractor shall inform the Contractor and seek consent to the Sub-Contractors proposals for resolving any inadequacy, departure, omission, discrepancy or divergence or error, and if the Contractor consents the inadequacy, departure, omission, discrepancy or divergence or error shall be dealt with in accordance with such proposals."

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.11.3 as follows: "Nothing in this clause 2.11 shall relieve the Sub-Contractor of its obligation to comply with Statutory Requirements or its responsibility for its design for the Sub-Contract Works."

children.name: text
children: In line 5 insert after "the Sub-Contractors Designed Works" the following: "of which the Sub-Contractor was not aware and which could not reasonably have been foreseen by a competent and experienced Sub-Contractor at the Sub-Contract Base Date."

children.name: text
children: Delete existing clauses 2.13.1, 2.13.2, and 2.13.4, renumber existing clause 2.13.3 as 2.13.9 and insert the following:

"2.13.1 The Sub-Contractor shall in exercising its responsibilities for the design of the Sub-Contract Works exercise (and hereby warrants that it has exercised) all the reasonable skill, care and diligence of a competent and properly qualified Architect, or as the case may be, such other appropriate and properly qualified designer experienced in carrying out and completing the design for works of the type, complexity, value and time scale of the Main Contract Works.
2.13.2 Subject always to clause 2.13.1, the Sub-Contractor shall be fully responsible and liable to the Contractor in all respects for:
.1 the Sub-Contractors design and development for the Sub-Contractors Designed Works whether prepared before, on or after the date of this Sub-Contract; and

.2 the selection of goods and materials (including any goods or materials specified in the Employers Requirements and/or Contractors Requirements) to the extent that: a) the selection has been or will be made by the Sub-Contractor or on its behalf; or

b) any incorrect selection contained in the Employers Requirements and/or Contractors Requirements that directly forms part of the requirements for the Sub-Contract Works would be expected to be able to be identified as incorrect at tender stage by an experienced sub-contractor carrying out sub-contract works of a similar size, type or complexity as the Sub-Contract Works, and was not so identified by the Sub-Contractor; and

.3 the satisfaction of performance specifications and requirements included in and/or specifically referred to in the Employers Requirements, the Contractors Requirements, any Variation and also the Statutory Requirements, the requirements of any Statutory Undertaker or other competent authority, all to the extent that such requirements are included in and specifically required by the Sub-Contract and/or any Variation, in each case insofar as relevant to the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: 2.13.3 The Sub-Contractor warrants and undertakes that it shall design for the Sub-Contractors Designed Works (subject always to clause 2.13.1 in relation to design) and construct the Sub-Contract Works:

.1 to the specified standards or to the extent not so specified, using best up to date practice and to standards consistent with those specified standards and to the extent that such requirements are included in and specifically required by the Sub-Contract and/or any Variation, in compliance with all relevant Consents, Statutory Requirements, BSI British Standards, codes of practice, manufacturers requirements, statutory orders and regulations made under or deriving validity from them and any requirements and codes of practice of local authorities affecting the Development current at the time the Sub-Contract Works are carried out;

.2 without infringement of any rights, reservations, covenants, restrictions, stipulations or other encumbrances binding upon or affecting the Development (save as may have been agreed in writing with the Contractor) insofar as details of the same have been expressly included and required by the Sub-Contract ; and

.3 ensuring proper integration, coordination and compatibility of the various components and elements that make up and comprise the Sub-Contract Works one with the other and, to the extent design details have been issued to the Sub-Contractor at the time of its design activity, with the interfacing parts of the Main Contract Works.

2.13.4 Any reference to the design which the Sub-Contractor has prepared and/or issued or shall prepare and/or issue for the Sub-Contractors Designed Works or any part thereof shall include a reference to any design which the Sub-Contractor has caused or shall cause to be prepared or issued by others, including Sub-Contractors Persons."

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.13.5 as follows:

"The Sub-Contractor has inspected the physical and other site conditions 
                          (conditions as would be discoverable upon inspection as at the date of this 
                            Sub-Contract and other conditions external to but affecting the Site 
                            including the land and structures adjacent to the Site, to the extent 
                            they relate to the Sub-Contract Works and/or are likely to affect the 
                            manner in which the Sub-Contract Works may be performed and has fully 
                            acquainted himself with the same and has reviewed all information 
                            issued to him as to risks, contingencies and related circumstances which 
                            may influence or affect the carrying out and completion of the Sub-Contract 
                            Works, including the means of access and facilities for storage and delivery 
                            of plant, materials and Sub-Contractors equipment. No failure on the part 
                            of the Sub-Contractor to discover, review or foresee any such conditions, 
                            to the extent that they were issued for review, reasonably discoverable or 
                            foreseeable, shall entitle the Sub-Contractor to an adjustment to the 
                            Sub-Contract Sum or to an extension of time. Subject to clause 2.10, the 
                            Sub-Contractor shall be entitled to rely upon any survey, report or other 
                            document prepared by or on behalf of the Contractor and which forms part of 
                            this Sub-Contract regarding any such matter as is referred to in this 
                            clause as to the accuracy of any such survey, report or document or for 
                            any representation or statement contained therein, whether made negligently 
                            or otherwise save where the Sub-Contractors obligations of performance under 
                            this Sub-Contract include a requirement to consider and/or verify the accuracy 
                            or completeness of and/or to identify any relevant discrepancies within or between 
                            any such survey, report or document."

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.13.6 as follows:

"Without prejudice to the Sub-Contractors other obligations under this Sub-Contract, to the extent that the Sub-Contractor is responsible for selection of goods and materials, the Sub-Contractor warrants that it has not used, specified for use or permitted the use and shall not use, specify for use or permit the use in the Sub-Contractors Works any Prohibited Materials. In the event the Sub-Contractor becomes aware that any Prohibited Materials or combinations of Prohibited Materials have been or may be used in the Development the Sub-Contractor shall immediately notify the Contractor."

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.13.7 as follows:

"The Sub-Contractor will not vary, amend, change, 
                          add to or alter the Sub-Contract Works or any part 
                          thereof as described in the Sub-Contract Documents, 
                          or any of the Sub-Contractors Design Documents which 
                          become part of the Sub-Contractors Works, without first obtaining the prior written approval of the Contractor. In seeking the written approval of the Contractor, the Sub-Contractor shall provide to the Contractor adequate details of the proposed variation, amendment, change, addition or alteration including relevant performance and qualitative criteria in relation to any materials and highlighting and detailing on any Sub-Contractors Design Documents the nature of the proposed variation, amendment, addition or alteration. Any additional cost to or delay in the Sub-Contract Works and/or the Main Contract Works arising out of any such variation, amendment, change, addition or alteration shall be borne by the Sub-Contractor unless such variation, amendment, change, addition or alteration is as a result of an instruction from the Employer or Contractor which is not due to any discrepancy or omission caused by the Sub-Contractor."

children.name: text
children: Add a new clause 2.13.8 as follows:

"The Sub-Contractor shall not during the period of its employment under this Sub-Contract or at any time after the expiry or termination of this Sub-Contract or of the Sub-Contractors employment hereunder disclose to any person (other than Sub-Contractors Persons in the proper course of their duties relative to this Sub-Contract and the Sub-Contractors legal or other advisors, and law enforcement or other regulatory bodies insofar as the Sub-Contractor is required by law) any information not already in the public domain relating to this Sub-Contract, the Sub-Contract Works and/or the Development. The Sub-Contractor shall ensure that any persons having access to such information are aware of these obligations and are similarly bound by them."

children.name: text
children: "No Site Materials delivered to the Main Contract Works or the Sub-Contract Works shall be The Employer’s Agentd without the Contractors written consent. Any materials and goods whether delivered to the Site or otherwise, the value of which is included in an Interim Payment under the Main Contract, or for which payment has been made by the Contractor to the Sub-Contractor before their value is included in any Interim Payment under the Main Contract, or on delivery to the Site, whichever first occurs, shall, be and become the property of the Contractor. The Sub-Contractor shall indemnify the Contractor from and against any expense, liability, loss, claim, cost or proceedings whatsoever arising from any failure to pass to the Contractor a complete and unencumbered title in any materials or goods. The value under the Sub-Contract of all materials and goods for which title is transferred pursuant to this clause, and for which the Sub-Contractor has not previously received payment from the Contractor, shall become due and included for payment in the next interim Payment Notice. The Contractor shall be liable to the Sub-Contractor for the full unpaid value of any such property until such payment is made."

children.name: text

children.name: text
children: Delete the existing clause 2.25.2 and insert: "The Sub-Contractor hereby grants to the Contractor and to the Employer with full title guarantee an irrevocable non-exclusive royalty free licence to copy and use any Sub-Contractors Design Documents and to reproduce and adapt any designs contained in them for any purpose whatsoever relating to or connected with the Development including (but without limitation) the execution, completion, mortgaging, letting, management, sale, advertisement, extension, occupation, modification, alteration, maintenance, reinstatement, repair, use and financing (including refinancing) of the same and the Sub-Contractor shall ensure that the Contractor is provided with hard and electronic copies of the Sub-Contractors Design Documents as requested. Such licence shall carry the right to grant sub-licences, and shall be freely transferable to the Employer and by the Employer to third parties. The Sub-Contractor shall, if so requested, at any time, execute such documents and perform such acts as may be required to give full effect to the licence granted pursuant to this clause 2.25.2, including procuring the grant of intellectual property licences from third parties."

children.name: text

children.name: text
children: Insert the following new clause: "3.20A The Sub-Contractor warrants to the Contractor that: 3.20A.1 it has competence to perform the obligations imposed on it under this Sub-Contract in respect of the CDM Regulations, and to conduct its undertaking without contravening any prohibition contained in the CDM Regulations; and 3.20A.2 it has advised and supported and will continue to advise and provide support to the Contractor to assist the Contractor in performing its duties imposed by the CDM Regulations; and 3.20A.3 it has allocated or (as appropriate) will allocate adequate resources to enable it to comply with the obligations described in clauses 3.20 and 3.20A."
